name: Dream Hunter Remu -Inmu no Ryakudatsusha-
original_name: ドリームハンター麗夢 淫夢ノ略奪者
source:
Remu Ayanokouji, a girl who has solved numerous mysteries while asleep, now found herself standing in front of the demon pillaging the dream world, and his servants!
They charge Remu, assaulting her in numerous ways.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037231.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
绫小路雷梦，一个在睡梦中解决了无数谜团的女孩，现在发现自己站在掠夺梦境世界的恶魔和他的仆人面前！
他们冲向雷姆，以多种方式攻击她。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037231.html]DLsite English[/url]]
